text:
sam: Heads-up: seeing a large spike in apiserver 504s in eu-central1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Pod attach for GPU workloads failing intermittently. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/CP/apiserver-etcd

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (apiserver 504 surge - eu-central1) :rotating_light:

elaine: looking at etcd metrics — fsync p95 is huge, and wal fsync latency spikes correlate with the apiserver errors.

cheng: any recent rollouts in that region? controller-manager restarts?

sam: yes, there was a controller-manager config tweak ~08:55 (reduced leader-election lease to 6s) for a canary. could be noisy.

mike: quick check: `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -o wide | grep controller-manager` shows rapid restarts on two nodes in eu-central1. Also seeing `etcd_disk_wal_fsync_ms` jump to 1200ms.

elaine: console snapshot: ```
# etcd metrics snippet
etcd_disk_wal_fsync_ms_bucket{le="100"} 0
etcd_disk_wal_fsync_ms_bucket{le="1000"} 3
etcd_disk_wal_fsync_ms_bucket{le="+Inf"} 12
```

ira: IO team pinged — they see NVMe queue depth saturation on the etcd nodes in that AZ. Might be noisy backups + snapshot compaction overlap.

cheng: mitigation idea: rollback the leader-election lease tweak (makes leader churn more aggressive), throttle compact/snapshot jobs, and restart controller-manager pods one at a time.

sam: doing a controlled rollback now:
```
kubectl -n kube-system set env deployment/controller-manager LEASE_DURATION=15s
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/controller-manager
```

mike: also temporarily scaled etcd IO priority via node-level ionice on the etcd systemd unit on the affected instances (ops-runner applied).

oncall-bot: Patch applied by ops-runner @ 09:28 UTC — ops-runner: lowered backup IO concurrency on eu-central1 etcd replicas.

elaine: post-mitigation: wal fsync p95 dropped from ~1200ms -> ~80ms, apiserver 504 rate down to baseline within ~3m. logs show fewer watch reconnects.

sam: rolling verification with a couple GPU attach tests: `kubectl apply -f test-gpu-pod.yaml` -> attach success.

ira: opened follow-up runbook ticket: RW-OPS-2026 (add IO throttling guard for etcd snapshots, stricter scheduling of compaction windows).

cheng: note for eng-platform: avoid aggressive leader-election tuning during maintenance windows; prefer canary on staging first.

mike: :thumbsup: good catch. tagging this as resolved for now, will keep monitoring.

sam: marking thread resolved, follow-ups in RW-OPS-2026 and INC-2026-042. :white_check_mark:
